visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A right hand holding a yellow tennis ball with the 'KONG' logo occupies the foreground. A brown and white Corgi stands on a red-brick paved ground looking up expectantly at the ball. In the background, another Corgi sniffs near a tree surrounded by a concrete border. The lighting is bright natural daylight. (2) The camera pans right, revealing a wide, open intersection with a zebra crossing. In the distance, a traditional temple-style building with a yellow and red roof sits atop a slight hill against a backdrop of green mountains and a blue sky with fluffy white clouds. (3) The camera continues to pan, showing a large, leafy banyan tree on the left and a parked white delivery truck with license plate 'K3-008' on the back. A Corgi walks across the red bricks towards the truck in a wide shot. (4) The scene shifts to a circular concrete structure with stairs and palm trees in the background. A black stone monument with gold lettering stands on a red base. A Corgi walks past the monument, sniffing the ground and the base of the stone before pausing to look around.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 我們今天帶他們來一個非常非常懷念的地方. (2) [Subtitle]: 先讓多多玩球. (3) [Subtitle]: 就是我們以前的路邊一棵... (4) [Subtitle]: 結果那個榕樹不見了. (5) [Subtitle]: 榕樹現在變掉、變短了. (6) [Subtitle]: 之前呢是有一個很大棵的榕樹. (7) [Subtitle]: 那舅舅大大多多會在這邊玩. (8) [Subtitle]: 唉，歲月啊. (9) [Subtitle]: 這個世界一直在改變. (10) [Subtitle]: 你看以前我們帶三隻狗在這邊做直播. (11) [Subtitle]: 然後在榕樹下. (12) [Subtitle]: 然後他們在樹下休息. (13) [Subtitle]: 現在一眨眼，剩兩隻. (14) [Subtitle]: 然後我們也老了. (15) [Subtitle]: 我血壓也開始變高了. (16) [Subtitle]: 這就是人生啊.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a personal nostalgic vlog where the narrator revisits a meaningful location from his past. By highlighting changes in the environment (the cut banyan tree) and his own life (having fewer pets and aging), the content aims to share a warm, slightly melancholic reflection on the passage of time and the inevitability of change.
